instructions: Hydralysis 0.8.0. Twenty-one tools for any PE you own. prepare adopts an analysed project in place, or imports/analyses a new executable exactly once as a durable job, and registers its build; backend discovers/installs the engines, never their MCPs. job reports progress. runtime manages verified debugging/instrumentation sessions. inspect is the function picture (bounds, prologue, instructions, callers) and does not start a JVM. sigscan and prologue are how a hook site is found and checked. ghidra_run runs one of your scripts contained, so it cannot change the project. Prefer ghidra_query for bounded address-based decompilation and references; one warm engine serves CLI, MCP and script clients; export writes bulk artifacts as a job. Addresses there are VAs or explicit rva:/va:. For PE addresses use rva:0x... or va:0x... when the interpretation is ambiguous. trace records and queries what a program did (cited, bounded, with coverage gaps); capture itself is runtime. Do not re-import the binary. evidence_add stores a claim only with a source.

tools.name: fingerprint
tools.description: PE build identity and packing triage. detail=sections/exports returns those tables.

tools.name: imports
tools.description: Imported symbols and IAT slots (xrefs on a slot: its callers); pattern filters.

tools.name: disasm
tools.description: Disassemble at an RVA or VA. 64-bit rip-relative operands show their target.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Cheap PE inspection: x64 pdata bounds, instructions, candidate callers. For analysed bounds/decompile use ghidra_query.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: xrefs
tools.description: References to an address. 64-bit rip-relative LEA/MOV, 32-bit absolute.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: callers
tools.description: Direct E8/E9 sites in executable code that land on an address.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: callees
tools.description: Direct E8 calls made from the function that contains an address.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: function
tools.description: The pdata function that contains an address, and its first 32 bytes.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: bytes
tools.description: Raw bytes at an address.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: strings
tools.description: Printable strings matching a regular expression.

tools.name: sigscan
tools.description: Find a byte pattern in executable sections. ?? is a wildcard. Use this to locate a hook site.

tools.name: prologue
tools.description: Verify one prologue or checks[{address,expect (or a list),name?}] against a PE build's file bytes; with session, live bytes and who patched them. Any mismatch fails.

address.description: Use rva:/va:; ambiguous unprefixed addresses are refused.

tools.name: evidence_add
tools.description: Store one proved claim (note and source required), attributed to this client; subsystem groups it; supersedes=<id> replaces an older claim, keeping it.

tools.name: evidence_list
tools.description: Claims, newest first, by target/subsystem/address/build; superseded ones on request. export=<path.md> writes a subsystem (and .jsonl).

tools.name: ghidra_run
tools.description: Run your Ghidra script on saved analysis; contained and rolled back.

tools.name: ghidra_query
tools.description: Query saved analysis; pages use next_cursor. address_map imports cited name/hash maps; export starts a job. decompile: options.max_characters clips the C text, max_result_mb bounds the whole reply; truncated/fragments mark a partial result. See backend help.

tools.name: backend
tools.description: Discover/install private analysis or runtime engines, never other MCPs. install returns a durable job. status/stop the shared engine. doctor and backups take options. help gives operation options.

tools.name: prepare
tools.description: Register a build: adopt an analysed project in place (path=.gpr or folder; hash-checked, no copy), or start a one-time import/analysis job. plan is read-only.

tools.name: job
tools.description: Job status, bounded logs or cancel (needs owner, its start's owner_token). No id lists every client's jobs.

tools.name: runtime
tools.description: Own-process debugging/instrumentation sessions: spawn/attach, modules, memory, verified probes/breakpoints, registers, continue and detach. Use backend help for options.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Semantic traces: what a running or recorded program did, cited and bounded. Actions start/stop (capture via runtime), status, query, diff, explain, mark, export, check, import, resymbolize, reprocess, relations, evict, bundle. Replies carry counts, event ids, revision and coverage gaps. See backend help.
